title: Operations Associate
description:
About Unity Advisory

Unity Advisory is a pure-play, experience-led CFO advisory firm providing integrated finance, commercial, tax and deals support. We are free from audit conflicts and AI-enabled by design, combining deep technical expertise with automation, analytics and AI built into the delivery of every engagement. We are building an alternative to traditional advisory firms, focused on clarity over complexity, outcomes over hours, and practical advice delivered at pace for CFOs making high-consequence decisions.

The Role

This is an office-based role providing hands-on coordination across day-to-day operations and partner recruitment processes, keeping information accurate, stakeholders supported, and business administration running smoothly. The role also acts as back-up Executive Assistant support when required.

Responsibilities

• Provide office management support – supplies, ordering, general office coordination, handling enquiries.

• Provide ad hoc Executive Assistant cover when required – scheduling, travel bookings, and administrative support.

• Support KYC administration and related process tasks.

• Issue and file confidential documentation via DocuSign; use Wordsmith to generate and send NDAs.

• Support invoicing and expenses in Dynamics 365 (including scheduling board support and timesheets).

• Maintain HubSpot hygiene (adding contacts, logging meetings and notes) as needed.

• Provide additional operational administration and procurement support as required.

• Coordinate partner recruitment activity, maintain candidate pipelines, and keep records up to date in Ashby (ATS).

• Schedule partner interviews and meetings, manage diaries, and support end-to-end partner recruitment coordination, preparing interview and meeting packs (background research, partner candidate summaries) and proactively chasing progress through stages.

• Support onboarding logistics for new partner starters (access, comms, and key recurring meetings).

• Review Payhawk expenses for completeness and accuracy (including tax treatment where required).

• Proactively identify process gaps across recruitment, onboarding, office operations, and core systems, helping to improve workflows, documentation, reporting, and stakeholder follow-up.

What You'll Bring

• Highly organised with strong attention to detail and comfort managing multiple priorities.

• Confident communicator with discretion when handling confidential information.

• Strong scheduling and stakeholder-management skills.

• Systems confident (ATS, Dynamics 365, Payhawk, DocuSign, HubSpot) and quick to learn new tools.

• Curious and looking to grow, adopting new technologies and ways of working.

• Willing to go beyond the immediate ask to ‘what's next’.

• Comfortable using AI tools, including Claude and ATS, to build business case testers and background prompts that help drive the interview process.

Work Environment

Office based, London (Mayfair). This role sits close to the day-to-day rhythm of the business and works closely with Talent, Operations, and Executive Assistant colleagues.

Additional Information

At Unity Advisory, we are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. In line with the Equality Act 2010, we will accommodate any suitable candidate requiring assistance to attend or conduct an interview. If you need any adjustments or support, please let us know when scheduling your interview or in your application cover letter. We are dedicated to ensuring everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and are here to support you throughout the process.

PLEASE NOTE: We do not accept unsolicited CVs from third-party agencies.

title: Forward Deployed Investor
description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Role

9fin's buy-side clients are the capital behind the credit markets. Credit funds, CLO managers, private credit platforms, and distressed investors run research, underwriting, portfolio monitoring, and relative value workflows that are deep and specialised. They are actively excited about what AI can unlock. Our job is to make that potential real inside their investment teams.

The Forward Deployed Investor is the person who does it. You are a domain expert who has done the work yourself, and you can credibly sit across the table from a portfolio manager, a private credit underwriter, or a distressed analyst and say: "Here is how this changes the way you invest."

You will work with 9fin's most strategic buy-side clients, drive deep adoption of our existing AI capabilities across the investment process, and become a critical voice in shaping what we build next. Every client engagement is a source of product intelligence. The insights you bring back from the front line will directly influence 9fin's AI product roadmap and sharpen how we win the next generation of buy-side accounts.

 

What You Will Do

  • Map investment workflows and find the highest-value insertion points. Embed with client teams to document how sourcing, screening, underwriting, credit committee preparation, portfolio monitoring, and relative value work actually gets done end-to-end. Identify the three to five places where 9fin's AI can materially change the workflow. Co-author adoption success criteria with the client, tied to their investment outcomes.

  • Build 9fin's AI into those workflows. Take the identified insertion points and build them out using 9fin's toolkit: in-platform capabilities, MCP integrations, agents, and future capabilities as they ship. Weighted by workflow depth, not count. Iterate based on real usage behaviour, not intended usage.

  • Drive adoption at your served accounts. Onboard named users across investment, research, and risk. Run enablement sessions with power users, identify and support champions inside the client. Monitor active usage and address dormant seats before they become churn signals. Review adoption monthly with client champions and quarterly with the CIO, head of research, or equivalent sponsor.

  • Feed the field back into 9fin. Every deployment produces structured intelligence, fed to two consumers. First, product and engineering: prioritised requests tied to specific account and workflow context, patterns extracted across deployments. Second, the wider GTM cycle: case studies, demo assets, workflow evidence, and competitive intelligence that sharpen the next GTM cycle.

  • Spot expansion. Identify opportunities inside served accounts for new users, new use cases, new departments, or new products. Document with context and hand to Account Management for commercial follow-up.

 

What You Bring

You are a subject matter expert with 3+ years of practitioner experience at an asset manager, credit fund, or insurer, with fluency across end-to-end investment workflows in your area, not just the data those workflows consume. Specifically, in one or more of the following:

  • Credit portfolio management and research. High yield, leveraged loan, or multi-strategy credit investing, covering screening, underwriting, credit committee process, and ongoing portfolio monitoring

  • Private credit and direct lending. Origination, underwriting, documentation review, or portfolio monitoring at a private credit or direct lending platform

  • CLO investing. CLO management, warehouse and portfolio construction, or CLO debt and equity tranche investing

  • Distressed and special situations. Stressed and distressed credit analysis, restructuring and process tracking, documentation and covenant analysis, or capital structure work

  • Buy-side transformation, data, or research technology functions. Investment data, quantitative or systematic credit research, chief data office, digital transformation, or AI strategy roles where you have led or contributed to AI and workflow transformation projects specifically in credit investing

Beyond your domain expertise, you are:

  • Demonstrably interested in technology applied to your domain. For example: participation in an internal AI, data, or research technology working group; external vendor champion or evaluation lead for domain tech. You may have already moved to a technology company focused on credit markets.

  • Familiar with and hands-on with modern domain tooling. Direct user experience of Rogo, Hebbia, AlphaSense, Octus, or comparable AI-native platforms in your workflow. You can speak from experience about what works, what doesn't, and why.

  • Comfortable operating inside confidential investment processes. You will sit close to live pipelines, positions, and internal research. You are disciplined about what does and does not travel between accounts, and clients trust you quickly because of it.

  • A strong communicator across styles and audiences. Extremely comfortable with the analysts who will be the day-to-day platform users. Highly credible with portfolio managers, heads of research, and CIOs. Strong writing and in-person skills. Able to flex style for technical and business audiences.

  • Highly collaborative across a broad internal network. The function operates in close partnership with GTM, Product, Engineering, and other 9fin teams. You are energised by cross-functional work, you bring people with you rather than working around them, and you know how to translate what you are learning in the field into inputs that other teams can act on.

  • Outcome-oriented. You measure success by whether clients are actually using the platform differently, not by how many meetings you held or decks you delivered.

 

Why Join 9fin

  • Category leadership. 9fin is the reference platform for debt capital markets data and AI. Buy-side clients use us because there is no comparable alternative.

  • A genuine domain-expert role. You bring credit investing expertise; we back you with the platform, the product team, and the mandate to make it real inside client organisations.

  • Direct influence on the product. Field intelligence from your deployments feeds the product roadmap. What you learn on the ground shapes what 9fin builds next.

  • Series C stage, growing fast. Small enough that your work is visible, large enough to have the platform and customer base ready for real deployment.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

 

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Hybrid working model, to allow you the flexibility to decide how, where and when you do your best work

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Bi-annual team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

9fin is already the leading platform for legal intelligence in debt capital markets. Our proprietary AI capabilities extract and analyse legal language at scale, and our unique dataset of credit legal documentation delivers intelligence that generic AI tools simply cannot match.

Now we are investing to extend that leadership. You will lead a dedicated engineering team to define the next chapter of 9fin's legal product — going deeper on AI, building richer workflows, and expanding into the law firm segment, where we see a significant TAM opportunity that is ours to capture.

Your users sit at the centre of the debt markets ecosystem: origination teams at top investment banks, lawyers at leading law firms, and credit analysts at hedge funds and credit funds.

This is a great opportunity to shape the future of a product and a company that's using technology to revolutionise the trillion-dollar debt capital market.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Strategy: Define and champion the product vision and strategy for the Covenants squad from the ground up, working closely with engineering, our legal analysts, and key customers to establish what to build and why.

  • Problem definition & structured thinking: Synthesise insights from in-house legal subject matter experts (SMEs), customer interviews, customer feedback and data signals to craft a clear problem statement, articulating the root cause in a structured way.

  • Discovery: Use a range of techniques to identify and understand what users need and their workflows, across a sophisticated professional audience spanning credit analysts, portfolio managers, restructuring advisors, and law firms.

  • Impact driven: Align the team around a key outcome and effectively prioritise initiatives across multiple dimensions.

  • Measuring success: Proactively identify and track metrics to measure client and business benefit. Work with the team to define and manage a process for continuous model evaluation and improvement, with particular attention to the accuracy and reliability standards required in legal contexts.

Team Leadership & Communication

  • Team success: Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work.

  • Communication: Ensure all people involved are aware of the team's strategy, initiatives, and progress. You must be able to effectively communicate complex legal and financial concepts to technical audiences, and similarly communicate technical capabilities to legal and credit professionals.

  • Influence: Build strong relationships to empower the squad to achieve the desired outcome, often by influencing stakeholders outside of your team.

  • Stakeholder management: Work closely with stakeholders, including 9fin's legal analysts, credit team to gather the right input and insights. You will need to listen carefully and bring people on a journey.

AI Product Development

  • Own the roadmap for AI-powered legal document extraction and covenant analysis, ensuring outputs meet the precision standards required for professional use.

  • Partner with software and AI engineering to define evaluation frameworks for AI outputs in legal contexts, where accuracy, source attribution, and explainability are critical to user trust.

  • Identify opportunities to apply emerging AI capabilities to novel legal workflow problems, from covenant compliance monitoring to cross-document analysis across deal histories.

About You

This role will be a great fit if:

  • You have a legal or financial markets background, or have built products for this audience. You may have started your career as a lawyer, paralegal, or credit analyst, or you may have been a PM at a legal tech company. You are able to hold a substantive conversation about credit agreements, covenant packages, and how legal language governs capital structures. A sharp PM from an adjacent domain who can demonstrate rapid domain immersion will also be considered.

  • You are a strategic thinker who thrives with a blank page. You are comfortable defining strategy from scratch, not just executing an existing roadmap. You can synthesise ambiguous inputs into a clear direction and bring a team with you.

  • You're a collaborative leader. You have an empathetic leadership style and build strong, effective relationships. You love working autonomously but are able to earn the trust of others with a collaborative style. You are great at prioritising, not afraid to say no, and excel at managing stakeholders while also being confident in voicing your own opinions and challenging others.

  • You've got hands-on experience with AI. You have experience with or a working knowledge of AI and LLMs, including how to evaluate model outputs in production environments. You understand what good looks like when AI is applied to high-stakes, precision-dependent workflows, and you can engage meaningfully with engineering teams on evaluation design and quality standards.

  • You work in an AI-native way. You use generative AI tools as a natural part of how you work: prototyping ideas, conducting research, reviewing PRDs, and building agents or automated workflows to extend your own productivity. You are comfortable using coding assistants to get things done faster and are genuinely excited about what this shift means for how product work gets done. This is not a nice-to-have. We expect our PMs to be at the frontier of how AI accelerates product development.

  • You thrive building from zero. You are energised by the opportunity to define something new rather than optimise something established. You move quickly, make decisions with incomplete information, and course-correct based on evidence.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

Summary

Menlo Security is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Threat Protection and ShadowAI team in the UK. This team ensures that users can safely browse the web through Menlo's secure cloud — protecting them from malicious sites (including those built or operated with AI) and securing access to authorised web applications. The services this team builds are core to Menlo's secure enterprise browser for both humans and AI agents, which puts you at the centre of one of the most active problems in enterprise security right now: how organisations gain visibility into and control over unsanctioned AI usage without blocking it entirely. The team applies AI in how it builds as well — code assistants, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-supported log and incident analysis — so you will be using these tools alongside defending against their misuse.

Outcomes & KPIs

Key Outcome(s) Owned:

  • Detection accuracy for AI application and malicious site coverage, measured by false positive and false negative rates.

  • Build highly available, scalable distributed systems and APIs, including multithreaded and asynchronous applications, with performance and security considered from the start.

  • Build and refine the detection and policy capabilities that give customers visibility into generative AI and unsanctioned web application usage in their environments.

  • Participate in building, deploying, and operating the Menlo Security platform in production, using dashboards, error reporting, metrics, and AI-assisted log and trace analysis to identify and resolve defects quickly.

  • Use AI code assistants and AI-assisted test generation as part of your normal workflow to move faster, while applying your own judgement on correctness, security, and maintainability before anything ships.

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field (BE, BTech, or Masters), or equivalent practical experience.

  • Practical fluency with AI coding and debugging assistants, including sound judgement about when to rely on LLM output and when to verify it independently.

title: Head of New Business (m/f/d) - EMEA
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Head of New Business — EMEA to lead and transform our regional new business function. This is a building role. You will report directly to the VP Sales EMEA and own the EMEA new business strategy, tactical plan, team, and execution of how Statista wins net-new logos across mid-market and enterprise accounts. You will work within Statista’s global commercial strategy while using regional insight to influence the evolution of our global playbooks and policies.

You will inherit a small, capable, and ambitious team — and the mandate to build it into the engine that powers our 2027 growth. You will shape and embed the EMEA playbook, raise the bar, and build a high-performance culture, working in close alignment with our global commercial framework.

What Success Looks Like — First 12 Months

Within your first 12 months, you will have:

  • Installed a consistent EMEA new-business operating cadence covering pipeline creation, qualification, deal inspection, and forecasting.

  • Built a repeatable mid-market and enterprise acquisition playbook across inbound, outbound, and account-based motions.

  • Raised sales capability through structured coaching and practical adoption of MEDDICC or an equivalent enterprise methodology.

  • Improved pipeline quality, forecast confidence, and economic-buyer engagement across the team.

  • Defined the team structure and hiring plan required to support Statista’s 2027 growth ambitions.

What You Will Own

  • Hiring, coaching, and developing a high-performing new business organisation, including Account Executives and close partnership with SDR leadership.

  • Building and embedding the operating cadence — pipeline reviews, deal inspection, forecast governance — that turns activity into outcomes.

  • Designing and implementing MEDDICC as an operational sales methodology, not a CRM form-fill, and holding the team to that standard.

  • Partnering with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Product, and the Statista Connect team to ensure inbound, outbound, account-based, and partnership motions operate as one commercial system.

  • Growing ARR through net-new acquisition and lifting average contract value through deliberate movement from user-level relationships to economic-buyer engagement.

  • Representing EMEA New Business in our global commercial leadership forums — bringing regional insight, evidence, and recommendations to help shape global strategy, standards, and playbooks.

What We Are Looking For

Experience

  • Significant experience leading B2B new-business teams, with evidence that you have built or materially improved a commercial function and delivered measurable growth.

  • Demonstrable track record of selling across both mid-market and enterprise contexts — comfortable with sub-€100k ACV velocity sales and €100k+ ACV multi-stakeholder enterprise cycles.

  • Proven ability to grow ARR and ACV in a comparable B2B SaaS, data, or intelligence platform environment.

  • Practical fluency in MEDDICC, MEDDPICC, or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with evidence that you have embedded the approach into coaching, deal inspection, and forecast governance.

Capability

You can demonstrate that you have:

  • Built a repeatable pipeline-generation motion across inbound, outbound, and account-based channels.

  • Increased ACV or enterprise mix while protecting sales-cycle discipline.

  • Improved forecast accuracy and pipeline quality through a structured management cadence.

  • Developed managers and reps through live deal coaching and consistent inspection.

  • Built or materially upgraded a sales motion in an environment where the playbook, operating cadence, and cross-functional model were still evolving.

Leadership

  • A hands-on leader — you sit in deal reviews, join customer calls, and coach in the moment.

  • You build cultures where reps learn from each other under a clear standard, not only from you.

  • You influence beyond your direct authority — across Marketing, Product, RevOps, and Hamburg HQ — to shape outcomes that need cross-functional alignment.

Desirable

  • Experience in data, intelligence, research, or information services.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce and sales enablement tooling.

  • Experience working across multiple European markets.

Why Join Statista

  • A direct line to the VP Sales EMEA — fast decisions, clear accountability.

  • Real ownership of EMEA new business strategy and tactical execution, within Statista’s global commercial framework.

  • Visibility across global sales leadership and access to Hamburg HQ.

  • The chance to define what ‘good’ looks like for an EMEA function still being built.

  • A product story — Connect, Statista+, AI-ready data infrastructure — that is only getting stronger.

Recruitment Process

Shortlisted candidates will move through a structured process:

  • Initial screen with Talent Acquisition.

  • In-depth conversation with the VP Sales EMEA.

  • 90-day strategic plan presentation.

  • Final conversation with the CCO.

Inclusive Application

Statista is committed to building an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from candidates with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We recognise that strong candidates may not meet every listed criterion. If the role interests you and your experience is relevant, we encourage you to apply.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The Team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Onchain Product team is building the next generation of financial products at Kraken, leveraging blockchain infrastructure to deliver faster, more transparent, and globally accessible financial services.


The team sits at the intersection of crypto, DeFi, and traditional finance, owning products that enable customers to earn yield, access tokenized assets, interact with onchain protocols, and participate in the emerging onchain economy. Working closely with Engineering, Design, Growth, Legal, and Partnerships, the team is responsible for identifying new opportunities, bringing innovative products to market, and helping position Kraken at the forefront of onchain finance.

 

The opportunity

  • Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for Kraken’s hybridization efforts across Kraken Pro and Consumer

  • Shape and drive the broader onchain hybrid roadmap

  • Work across both Pro and Consumer, with particular emphasis on cross-functional alignment and advocating for roadmap priorities

  • Drive cross-functional execution across Engineering, Design, Growth, Security, Operations, and other stakeholders

  • Partner with internal teams and external ecosystem partners to evaluate integrations and expand capabilities

  • Help make complex on-chain experiences simple, intuitive, and accessible

  • Lead the full product lifecycle from discovery and prioritization through launch and iteration

  • Define and own key product metrics, using data and experimentation to drive continuous improvement

     

What You Bring

  • A proven track record of taking products from ideation through go-to-market and iteration

  • On-chain experience is required, with experience closer to the underlying on-chain ecosystem strongly preferred

  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build internal buy-in across competing priorities

  • Cross-functional social intelligence, including the ability to coordinate teams and navigate complex organizational dynamics

  • Experience advocating for product roadmaps, particularly in a consumer environment

  • Experience negotiating with external vendors, partners, or ecosystem participants

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust quickly across diverse teams

  • Technical fluency and comfort working with engineering, without needing to be the deepest technical expert in the room

  • Obsessive product sense with a consumer-first mindset — you sweat the details of every user interaction, use data to diagnose friction, and have an unrelenting drive to make experiences simpler, faster, and more intuitive

 

Nice to haves

  • Well-rounded interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust quickly across diverse, distributed teams

  • 4+ years of product management experience with a clear track record of shipping meaningful consumer-facing products, and prior crypto, Web3, trading, gaming or banking experience is required

title: Customer Care Associate - Enterprise
description:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

As a Customer Care Associate – Enterprise, you’ll be dedicated to one of our strategic enterprise accounts and play a critical role in delivering an exceptional customer experience. You’ll own the customer experience from the first point of contact, collaborating with the teams across implementation, customer success, and solutions engineering to drive resolution and ensure consistent delivery at enterprise scale.

This role combines day-to-day customer support with continuous improvement. You’ll develop a strong understanding of the customer experience, identify patterns and areas of friction, and help shape how we support Choco’s key customers at scale.

What you'll do

  • Own day-to-day customer support for a strategic enterprise account across chat, email, and WhatsApp, providing fast, empathetic, and effective resolutions.

  • Deliver against our service standards, taking responsibility for response and resolution times, SLAs, and customer satisfaction.

  • Troubleshoot and solve problems, diagnosing issues independently and bringing in the right internal teams when deeper technical or operational support is needed.

  • Partner with customer success and implementation to deliver against account priorities, coordinate upcoming changes, and resolve recurring customer issues.

  • Develop a detailed understanding of each account’s users, workflows, and operational context to resolve issues effectively and anticipate support needs.

  • Turn frontline customer insights into improvements, identifying recurring problems and helping improve our processes, documentation, product, and ways of working.

  • Contribute to how we scale Customer Care, sharing learnings across our global Care organization and supporting the coaching and coordination of external agents.

What you bring

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing role. Experience in B2B, SaaS, tech, or enterprise support is a strong plus.

  • Full professional proficiency in English and Turkish (C1+). Proficiency in French, German, or Spanish is a plus.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the judgment to diagnose issues, prioritize effectively, and follow them through to resolution.

  • The ability to operate in a high-volume environment. You can prioritize multiple conversations and requests without compromising the quality of the customer experience.

  • A genuinely customer-focused mindset. You communicate clearly, stay patient under pressure, adapt quickly, and work well across teams.

  • Ability to coach and develop external agents, helping them ramp up quickly and consistently meet the quality standards expected for our enterprise customers.

What you get

  • Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

  • Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

  • Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

  • In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).

  • Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.

If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.

Choco is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to ensuring that our technology is available and accessible to everyone. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Data Analytics Engineer I
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

You will be joining the Financial Infrastructure team, responsible for building and maintaining the core systems powering our internal financial ecosystem. Every year, we process hundreds of billions of events that have a financial impact on Checkout.com and our merchants. Our team is responsible for maintaining an accurate record of all financial data, the data integrity of our systems and ensuring our infrastructure meets regulatory and compliance obligations in a scalable, reliable and fault-tolerant manner.

 

As an Analytics Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in our mission to make our financial data capabilities world-class. You will work closely with our Finance and Treasury teams to translate their requirements into robust and intuitive data models. You will design and build the data pipelines necessary to process and transform large amounts of data that our systems generate. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and reliability of these data pipelines, as Checkout continues to scale as a business. You will have ownership over these processes, allowing you to take charge in maintaining a high standard of data quality.

 

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Design and build data pipelines to process data from our systems, services and applications.

  • Implement monitoring and alerting frameworks to ensure data pipeline performance and reliability.

  • Partner with other analytics engineers to design and implement scalable data models that support downstream business operations and analytical queries.

  • Ensure data governance and security standards are maintained across our systems.

  • Continuously evaluate and implement new technologies to improve our platform and systems.

  • Collaborate with Finance stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications and Service Level Agreements.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in an Analytics Engineering or Data Engineering role with a focus on large scale data transformation and data warehousing.

  • Excellent SQL coding skills.

  • Experience with cloud-based data warehouse technologies such as Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or AWS Redshift.

  • Experience with data transformation tools such as dbt, or Dataflow.

  • Understanding of data modeling techniques.

  • Experience with using visualisation platforms such as Looker, Tableau, or Apache Superset.

  • Understanding of software engineering best practices and their application to data processing systems.

  • Knowledge of Python, Java or Flink is a plus, but not a necessity.

  • Strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Learning and Development Lead - Clinic
description:
This is a brilliant opportunity for an experienced Learning & Development professional who wants to build something, not simply inherit it.

As our clinical teams continue to grow, we are looking for someone to take real ownership of how our doctors, nurses, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals are onboarded, trained and prepared to work confidently at Montu.

You do not need to be a clinician. What we need is someone who really understands learning, knows how to engage experienced professionals and can take complex systems, processes and information and turn them into practical training that works.

There is plenty to shape, improve and build in this role, so if you love creating great learning experiences and seeing people go from day one to confident and capable, this could be a really exciting opportunity.

What is the job?

Great patient care starts with people who feel confident, capable and fully prepared to work within Montu’s model of care.

As Montu continues to grow, we are looking for a Clinic Learning & Development Lead to take ownership of how our clinicians are onboarded and trained.

You will build and deliver structured training for all our healthcare professionals including doctors, nurses, pharmacists and physiotherapists, helping them become ready to work independently as efficiently and safely as possible.

This is a hands-on role covering everything from systems and formulary training to eligibility, prescribing processes and patient pathways. You do not need to be a registered healthcare professional. We are looking for an experienced trainer who can take complex information and turn it into clear, practical learning.

What will you be doing?

Own clinician onboarding

You will manage the training journey from a clinician joining Montu through to being ready to work independently.

You will:

  • Design and deliver structured onboarding for different clinician groups alongside our lead training clinician.

  • Coordinate training and track progress.

  • Identify knowledge gaps, delays or barriers and provide additional support where needed.

  • Continuously improve the onboarding experience.

Deliver practical Montu training

You will train clinicians on the systems, processes and pathways they need to work effectively at Montu, including:

  • Clinical systems and patient portal

  • Patient eligibility and suitability

  • Prescribing processes and standards

  • Prescription pathways

  • Documentation and record keeping

  • SOPs, governance and escalation pathways

Training should be practical and engaging, using demonstrations, workshops, system practice, case-based learning and assessments.

Build capability

You will develop clear learning outcomes and assess understanding throughout training, working closely with clinical leaders and subject matter experts to ensure content remains accurate and up to date.

Clinical standards and prescribing guidance will remain governed by Montu’s clinical leadership. This role is focused on learning, capability and operational readiness rather than making independent clinical decisions.

Improve and scale training

You will use feedback, data and operational insight to make onboarding faster, clearer and more effective as Montu grows.

This will include developing training materials and learning pathways, maintaining a central source of training content and supporting refresher training and the rollout of new systems and processes.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone with:

  • Strong experience in training, learning and development, onboarding or operational enablement.

  • Experience designing and delivering structured training programmes.

  • Excellent facilitation and coaching skills.

  • Confidence training experienced professionals.

  • The ability to simplify complex information.

  • Strong organisation and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience delivering systems and process training.

  • A continuous improvement mindset.

Experience within healthcare or another regulated environment would be a strong advantage, particularly if you have trained healthcare professionals.

You do not need to be a registered healthcare professional or have experience within cannabis-based medicine.

What does success look like?

You will help us create:

  • Faster progression from joining Montu to independent working.

  • A consistent onboarding experience across clinician groups.

  • Fewer avoidable delays and knowledge gaps.

  • Confident clinicians who understand Montu’s systems, formulary and pathways.

  • A scalable training framework that can grow with the organisation.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary

  • 25 days holiday, rising to 27 after one year and 30 after three years, plus bank holidays

  • 5% matched pension

  • Cycle-to-work scheme

  • Opportunities for development and progression

  • The opportunity to build and shape an important training function within a rapidly growing healthcare organisation

  • A dynamic, collaborative and patient-focused working environment

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines.

We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and delivering an exceptional standard of patient care.

As we continue to grow, ensuring everyone joining our clinical teams receives consistent, high-quality training will be fundamental to maintaining the quality of our service. This role will play a central part in making that happen.

title: People Operations Coordinator
description:
At Montu, we're growing fast - and every great employee experience starts long before someone's first day.

We're looking for a highly organised, people-focused People Operations Coordinator to own the journey from signed contract through to a new joiner's first weeks with us. You'll be responsible for ensuring every employee joins compliantly, on time, and with an exceptional experience, while helping us maintain the high standards expected of a regulated healthcare business.

This is a role for someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments, loves bringing order to complexity, and enjoys being the welcoming face that makes every new starter feel excited to join.

What You’ll Do:

You'll own the onboarding journey from signed offer to successful start date, ensuring every new joiner has everything they need while maintaining the highest compliance standards expected in a regulated healthcare environment.

This role is all about organisation, ownership and follow-through. You'll be managing multiple onboarding journeys at once, keeping stakeholders on track, and making sure no detail is missed.

You will:

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding process for every new starter, ensuring a seamless and welcoming experience

  • Chase and manage all pre-employment documentation, including Right to Work, DBS checks, references and professional registrations, ensuring nothing delays a start date

  • Confidently follow up with candidates, hiring managers and internal teams to keep onboarding moving - you're comfortable reminding busy people and know how to get things done

  • Coordinate multiple onboarding schedules each month, often welcoming large cohorts of new employees across different departments

  • Deliver engaging induction sessions and be the friendly face that welcomes every new joiner to Montu

  • Partner with Hiring Managers, IT, Payroll, Facilities and Compliance to ensure every new starter is fully set up before day one

  • Maintain accurate employee records across our HR systems, ensuring documentation is complete, compliant and audit-ready at all times

  • Spot bottlenecks, improve processes and help us scale our onboarding operation as the business continues to grow

  • Keep stakeholders updated on onboarding progress, escalating risks early to ensure start dates remain on track

If you’re a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and loves creating experiences that help people hit the ground running, you’ll fit right in.

What You’ll Bring:

You'll thrive in this role if you're naturally organised, persistent and enjoy bringing structure to busy environments.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Experience coordinating onboarding, compliance or employee administration within a healthcare or other highly regulated environment

  • Experience working in a high-growth business where priorities change quickly and no two days are the same

  • Exceptional organisational skills and the ability to juggle multiple deadlines without losing attention to detail

  • Confidence in managing stakeholders and following up on outstanding actions - you aren't afraid to politely chase documentation or keep senior people accountable

  • A proactive, solutions-focused mindset that keeps things moving without needing constant direction

  • Excellent communication skills and a warm, approachable style that makes new joiners feel welcome from the moment they accept their offer

  • High attention to detail and pride in maintaining accurate, compliant records

If you don’t meet every qualification but believe you have the drive and skills to make an impact, we encourage you to apply. We’re always looking for passionate individuals who are excited to support our mission and thrive in an ever-evolving, high-energy environment.

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

title: Consultant Neurologist PAYE
description:
Our patients have often tried everything. Years of appointments, medications that did not work, conditions that slowly took over their lives. By the time they reach us, many have run out of road with conventional treatment. You could be the clinician that changes that.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultant Neurologists to join our clinical team.

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical call on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is still a young field. The evidence base is growing, best practice is being written in real time, and you will have a genuine hand in shaping it.

You do not need experience with cannabis based medicines. You need sound clinical judgement, an open mind and an interest in doing things differently. We provide full specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks, so your time is spent where it matters: with patients.

What you will be doing:

  • Providing high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment

  • Conducting patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management

  • Contributing to clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practice

  • Supporting clinical governance and maintaining robust standards of patient care

  • Working closely within a multidisciplinary team of nurses and pharmacists

  • Taking part in ongoing training and development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBPMs)

What you need:

  • Full GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Neurology

  • A genuine interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

Why join us?

  • Highly competitive salary

  • Flexible working with full time or part time options

  • Comprehensive indemnity coverage. Montu covers all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us

  • Private healthcare scheme

  • No night shifts and no on call

  • CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders

  • A collaborative multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals

  • The chance to be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK

Training and development:

  • Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians, sponsored by Montu

  • Specialist training delivered by experts

  • Ongoing support on clinical protocols, prescribing practices and Montu's systems

Working arrangements:

  • Fully remote with flexible working hours and days

  • Standard sessions are 4 hours of patient consultations, and you choose your preferred days and hours

  • To support onboarding, we ask for a minimum commitment of 2 sessions per week (8 hours) initially, so you become confident with our platform

  • Appointments are 15 minutes for new and existing patients. Our multidisciplinary model means nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, so Consultants focus on prescribing and patient care

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines. We exist to transform lives by improving access to safe, effective treatment and delivering an exceptional standard of care. We move quickly, we care deeply about our patients, and we are building something that did not exist in UK healthcare five years ago.

If that sounds like your kind of place, we would love to hear from you.

Compensation: £190K – £275K

  • • Based on hours worked per week & experience £190K – £275K

title: AWS Security & Cloud Platform Consultant
description:
Tasks

AWS Security & Cloud Platform consultant

Location: London,UK

3months + Contract with possible extension

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced AWS Security & Cloud Platform Consultant to lead the technical execution of a large-scale Defensive AI and Bot Mitigation Proof of Value for a high-volume enterprise digital platform. The consultant will design, build, and deploy cloud-native security controls, observability solutions, traffic analytics, automation frameworks, and AI-assisted operational capabilities using AWS services and Infrastructure as Code.

The role requires deep expertise in AWS networking, CloudFront, WAF, security automation, observability, large-scale log analytics, and cloud-native delivery practices.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Security & Edge Protection

  • Design and implement AWS WAF and CloudFront-based protection architectures.
  • Configure managed rule sets, rate-limiting controls, traffic classification, and bot mitigation capabilities.
  • Implement layered security controls to identify and mitigate malicious traffic.
  • Build and optimize edge caching strategies to reduce origin load and operational costs.

Infrastructure as Code & Platform Engineering

  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform.
  • Contribute code through enterprise Git repositories and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Create reusable deployment templates, automation scripts, and operational runbooks.
  • Support deployment rehearsals and production release preparation.

title: Product Manager (Senior/Staff-level)
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

Synthesia ships more product, faster, than we ever have. AI has collapsed the cost of building which means the hard part is no longer making things, it’s making sure people actually adopt them. That’s the job of Growth, and we’re changing how we do it: instead of bolting Growth on after launch to optimise, we’re embedding a Growth PM into every core bet from day one, so how a product acquires, activates and scales is designed in from the first cycle.

We’re hiring a Growth Product Manager to report to our VP of Growth. You'll own the Growth surface for one of those bets while helping build a growth-led way of working across the company.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own Growth for a core product area end to end, acquisition, activation, adoption and retention, baked into the roadmap from the start, not retrofitted.

  • Partner closely with the core product PMs and engineers who own the surface, bringing high-impact growth ideas and working out where they fit, and getting the primitives exposed that let you build and scale on top.

  • Design growth into the product itself: discovery-led acquisition loops, and experiences that get users to their job-to-be-done in a couple of clicks (sometimes without opening the editor at all).

  • Rally teams around specific, measurable outcomes and help each one hit its goal faster through what you build together.

  • Work across engineering, marketing and GTM to make funnel- and journey-thinking a normal part of how we build.

Who you are

  • AI-native. You’ve driven AI into how a product or team works - not just worked somewhere that does AI. You use it daily, you’re curious about how the stack works, and you keep up as it moves (fast).

  • Scrappy and comfortable in ambiguity. You’ve taken something 0→1, you move fast, and you don’t need a clean brief or a stable roadmap to make progress. Constant change energises you rather than blocking you.

  • A builder of credibility. You win trust across teams quickly and can get engineers, PMs and GTM aligned around growth - even when that’s a new way of working for them.

  • Technically fluent and genuinely curious. You can hold your own with engineers on how things work and where the trade-offs are.

  • Outcome-driven. You anchor on the right metric and move it.

Requirements

  • Experience as a Product Manager with exposure to Growth. Depth in a single specific lever is a plus, not a prerequisite.

  • Demonstrable experience driving AI-native product or ways of working.

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, 0→1, frequently-disrupted environment.

  • Strong communication and the personality to build credibility and influence across functions.

  • Technical fluency to partner credibly with engineering.

Location

Remote from Europe or hybrid based from our London or Munich offices.

 

Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

 

Global benefits:

  • You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity.

  • You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays.

  • Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person.

  • Work from home budget

  • Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year

  • Generous referral scheme

  • Enhanced parental leave - maternity leave includes 16 weeks at full pay, and paternity leave includes 5 weeks at full pay (if your country’s government scheme offers more generous support, you receive whichever is greater - our enhanced policy or the local statutory benefit)

 

Benefits specific to UK:

  • Private healthcare via AXA for you with a discount for dependants

  • 5% pension match

  • Team lunches Tuesday-Friday in the office

  • Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

description:

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.


If you join us, you’ll be helping to improve the property industry for everyone. As a Customer Retention Specialist you’ll be ensuring our customers are getting the most out of our award-winning prospecting tool, Spectre. You’re a real self-starter, a great communicator, and a confident and talented problem-solver, who isn’t afraid of going above and beyond for our customers.


This is a fast-paced role where no two days are ever the same - on any given day, you could be running a strategy call, working a retention, spotting an upsell opportunity, or providing best practice guidance. You'll also work closely with other teams across the business, giving feedback on product development and technical issues, and supporting launches of new product features.

If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you’d fit right in!

A bit about you…

  • You have a background in Customer Success or Retentions, with real experience retaining customers and handling objections

  • You're a motivated self-starter who works well independently and is excited by the opportunity to help scale a business during a high-growth phase

  • You're highly organised with exceptional attention to detail

  • You are passionate about providing an exceptional customer experience and building lasting relationships

  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills (fluency in written and spoken English)

  • You're tech-savvy and genuinely open to picking up new tools and systems quickly, from our CRM to AI-assisted workflows - we care more about your curiosity and adaptability than which specific tools you've used before

Here's what you can expect to be working on as an L2 Customer Success Manager at Street Group

title: Business Automation Specialist - Customer Care
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we’re on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We’re trusted by more than 10,000 companies worldwide, including Wise, On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we’re tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we’re driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you’re excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we’d love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Business Automation Specialist – Customer Care

About the Role

Customer Care at Perk is being rebuilt around automation and AI. This role is for someone who likes taking a messy operational problem and turning it into something that runs in production.

As an Automation Specialist, you'll design and ship the systems that cut manual work, make agents faster, and improve what customers actually experience. You'll work across Make.com, Airtable, Zendesk, Claude, APIs, and whatever else the problem needs. Some days that's a workflow. Some days it's an AI tool with evals, guardrails, and a kill switch. The through-line is the same: get it from idea to live, then keep it reliable.

You'll partner with Operational Excellence, Customer Care Leadership, and Operations. You'll own delivery end to end, and you'll be measured on whether the things you build actually stick.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, test, and deploy solutions across Make.com, Airtable, Zendesk, Claude, APIs, and AI tooling.

  • Wire up multi-system integrations that remove real manual effort, not just move it around.

  • Own projects from the first sketch through production and ongoing improvement.

  • Stand up proper testing and validation environments so "it worked in my scenario" isn't the bar.

  • Turn business problems into technical designs, and flag new automation opportunities as you go.

  • Stay close after launch: watch adoption, fix what breaks, iterate on what underperforms

Build

  • Write automations that are maintainable, documented, and safe for someone else to pick up.

  • Monitor production systems, debug fast, and keep operational impact low when things go wrong.

  • Know when Make/Zapier-class tools are enough, and when the problem needs a different approach.

  • Keep an eye on new automation and AI capabilities, and bring the useful ones in deliberately.

Raise the bar

  • Be the person others ask when they're stuck on architecture, platform limits, or how to ship AI safely.

  • Review builds before they go live when that review actually reduces risk..

  • Create reusable components, patterns, and standards so the next build is faster and cleaner.

Teamwork

  • Sit with Opex and Operations until you understand the real problem, then design the right fix.

  • Shape discovery and scoping so solutions stay practical and maintainable.

  • Keep stakeholders clear on progress, risks, dependencies, and dates.

  • Feed operational feedback back into the next version.

What We're Looking For

  • Shipped production automations on Make.com, Zapier, Claude, or similar not just demos.

  • Worked with Airtable or comparable systems as a real ops backbone, not a side spreadsheet.

  • Built LLM-powered workflows with prompt craft, evaluation, and guardrails — and knows when the model shouldn't act alone.

  • Strong at debugging production systems under time pressure.

  • Can turn a fuzzy business request into something scalable and supportable.

  • Comfortable working with both technical and operational partners.

  • Prefers speed and ambiguity over perfect specs.

How We'll Know You're Winning

  • Automations that meaningfully cut manual work in Customer Care.

  • Multi-system builds that stay reliable once they're live.

  • High reliability, performance, and adoption — not just "launched".

  • Clear gains in operational efficiency, agent experience, and customer experience.

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Interview Process

Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual
Hiring Manager interview - 30-45mins Virtual
Assessment Interview - 30-60mins - In-person interview

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

title: Account Executive, LATAM
description:
Headquarters: Remote, US

 About Mixpanel

 Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com .

 About the LATAM Sales Team

 Mixpanel's LATAM Sales team owns the region end to end — sourcing net-new enterprise logos and expanding existing accounts across Latin America. As a standalone team rather than part of a broader vertical motion, LATAM Sales builds its own playbooks, buyer relationships, and market fluency specific to the region.

 About the Role

 The right candidate for this role runs a full sales cycle from first conversation to close, builds real fluency in the LATAM market and its buyers, and turns what they learn in the field into playbooks the rest of the team can use. Reporting to the Senior Manager of LATAM Sales, they own a territory end-to-end: sourcing net-new pipeline, expanding existing accounts, and applying a consistent qualification approach to every deal. They partner closely with Sales Engineering on technical discovery and with Marketing on messaging that reflects what's actually happening in the field. This is a role for someone who understands the LATAM region and its buyers, works well without a finished playbook, and helps build one as they go.

 Responsibilities

• Source, qualify, and close net-new enterprise business across LATAM, including new business units and subsidiaries inside existing accounts

• Drive expansion pipeline alongside Renewal Managers and Customer Value Managers

• Run full-cycle enterprise sales using MEDDPICC (or Mixpanel's chosen methodology) to qualify and manage every deal

• Forecast accurately and flag risk early, to your manager and in the CRM

• Build fluency in LATAM buyer personas, language, and common use cases, and apply region-specific discovery questions and positioning

Headquarters: Poland, Wrocław (Remote)

 Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

 Why this role matters:

 We are seeking a dynamic and pragmatic Scrum Master to join our diverse global team. As a Scrum Master, you will play a crucial role in supporting our Agile transformation. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about Agile and eager to take the first step in their career supported by an experienced Agile team.

 Vonage is entering an exciting new chapter, focused on consolidating and aligning a business that has grown and diversified through acquisition. This role will be part of the Lean Agile Center of Excellence (LACE) at Vonage. The LACE are implementing the Scaled Agile framework (SAFe) across the business to help align our teams and maximize the value they deliver. This role is a chance to get real experience of driving SAFe implementation you won’t get from training or certification.

 Your key responsibilities:

 With the support of the LACE team you will help to drive the Agile transformation across Vonage. Your role will focus specifically on introducing a strong Agile culture within one or more teams, and you will also have the opportunity to assist the Release Train Engineers with running of SAFe events.

• Train, mentor, and support teams to introduce and follow agile values, principles, and practices.

• Use a data driven approach to help teams monitor their performance and drive a culture of continuous improvement.

• Encourage open communication and active participation within and between teams.

• Identify and address impediments that could hinder the team's progress or productivity. Collaborate to find solutions and eliminate obstacles.

• Foster effective communication between team members and stakeholders. Ensure information flows smoothly and that everyone is aligned with the team’s goals and priorities.

• Support the Release Train Engineers with planning for and running SAFe events such as PI planning.

 What you'll bring

 Some experience as a Scrum Master with an awareness of one or more Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban or XP will be useful to succeed in this role. Transferable experience from different career paths is welcomed.

 The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic and open-minded and will be able to give examples of their pragmatic and outcome-driven approach. Due to the international nature of the team and the business, experience working in a multicultural setting would be beneficial.

 Required:

 Experience we consider a plus:
